occurrence_records.contaminant: tetracycline-class (chlortetracycline <0.05 ug/L; 12/37 pharmaceuticals detected, up to 8.84 ug/L for other compounds)

occurrence_records.note: 100% detection frequency in secondary sludge; risk quotient assessed for land application

occurrence_records.concentration: ng/L–ug/L ranges reported across African monitoring studies
occurrence_records.study: comparative datasets compiled in Olarinmoye 2016 discussion

one_health.human: clinical use + hospital effluent; carbapenem-era pressure to preserve last-resort tetracyclines (tigecycline)
one_health.animal: veterinary tetracyclines among most-used livestock antibiotics; aquaculture use in Nigeria reported
one_health.environment: sub-inhibitory ng–ug/L levels maintain selection pressure; sludge application recycles residues to soils (L12, L19)

persistence_summary: Generally low–moderate aqueous persistence (photolysis, hydrolysis, epimerisation); persists when sorbed to sediments/sludge (strong sorption to clay/organic matter and multivalent cations).
